classification.Preserved: All required public-language and approved carrier observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs, with a witness naming the observable and actual result.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, opacity or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.

observables.O-BINDING: math.accent is a callable function in the closed math module and produces canonical MathAccent identity rather than a generic sequence.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: The qualified function requires base then accent positionally, accepts only size and dotless as named, rejects missing, extra, positional-as-named, duplicate and unknown arguments, coerces string/none to base content, and type-checks relative length and boolean.
observables.O-NORMALIZATION: Accent input is exactly one character or one single-codepoint symbol. The canonical table maps aliases such as ^ to U+0302, ~ to U+0303, . to U+0307, and right arrow to U+20D7; an already canonical or unlisted single codepoint is retained.
observables.O-EXPLICITNESS: Omitted size and dotless are stored at defaults 100% + 0pt and true with independent false presence bits. Each explicitly supplied value sets only its own bit, including explicit default values.
observables.O-SET-PRECEDENCE: Effective size and dotless resolve independently as element-explicit, then cascaded math.accent property, then 100% + 0pt and true. Cascaded values never set element presence bits or appear in repr.
observables.O-ROUTE-CONVERGENCE: Qualified math.accent, bare accent and symbolic wrappers construct the same complete carrier for equivalent inputs. Wrappers fix their canonical accent but retain the public base, size and dotless behavior.
observables.O-CARRIER: MathAccent stores base Content, canonical accent char, Rel<Length> size, dotless bool and independent size/dotless presence bits.
observables.O-WALKERS: Clone, structural equality, hash, map_content and terminal map_text preserve accent, size, dotless and presence. map_content recurses only through base; plain_text appends the canonical accent codepoint to base text.
observables.O-OBSERVATION-RELATION: The applicable observation relation compares base, canonical accent, size, dotless and both presence bits. Any differing causal field is not silently normalized to Same.
observables.O-REPR: Canonical repr starts accent(base: ..., accent: canonical escaped string), appending size then dotless only when their respective presence bits are true. Effective cascaded values and derived orientation are absent.
observables.O-RECONSTRUCTION: apply_math_default, apply_math_style and all complete-content walkers transform only base where applicable and preserve canonical accent, size, dotless and both presence bits exactly.
observables.O-LAYOUT-UPPER: A non-bottom accent is placed above a cramped base using established accent attachment and AccentBaseHeight behavior; upper geometry remains attributable rather than inferred from bytes.
observables.O-LAYOUT-LOWER: An accent classified Below or one of U+23DF, U+23B5, U+23DD and U+23E1 is placed below an uncramped base and does not apply dotless transformation.
observables.O-SIZE: The horizontal stretch target is effective size resolved relative to base width, with a 0.5em short-fall. A 150% accent is observably wider than the same eligible accent at 100% on the same base, subject to available font variants.
observables.O-DOTLESS: For upper accents, effective dotless=true removes the visible dot from mathematical lowercase i/j before accent placement while preserving the public base carrier; false retains it. Lower accents ignore dotless.
observables.O-UPPER-REGRESSION: Previously certified simple and nested upper-accent attachment, baseline and ink-top behavior remain within the frozen semantic/geometric tolerances.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Identity mismatch, opaque construction/cascade/glyph/layout, unsupported observation, unreadable output, timeout, crash, OOM, swap, missing dependency or exhausted budget is Unknown and blocks mandatory acceptance.

cases.witness: type is function and result has canonical MathAccent repr.
accent U+0302, size 100% + 0pt, dotless true, both presence bits false; repr omits both optionals.
None base converts to empty content [].
Symbol content is accepted and normalized to its canonical char.
size is 150% + 0pt, size bit true, dotless bit false, and repr contains only size.
dotless false and only its bit are preserved and printed.
Both default-valued arguments remain explicitly present in canonical order.
Named arguments may precede the two positionals and retain independent presence.
Carrier bits remain false and repr omits optionals while layout uses 150% and dotted i.

mutation_requirements: drop registration or return generic content
accept arbitrary accent content or skip canonical normalization
collapse independent explicitness bits or infer presence from values
let cascade overwrite an explicit element value or leak into repr
make bare or symbolic wrapper routes discard size/dotless
omit a carrier field from equality, hash, walkers or reconstruction
always position accents above or always apply cramped/dotless
ignore effective size or resolve it against font size instead of base width
ignore dotless, apply it when false, or mutate public base content
grant success from render bytes, opaque extraction or Unknown

gates.preseal: Manifest, contract, oracle suite, mutation suite, executor bindings, hashes and three execution orders are frozen before candidate admission.

discriminatory.score_formula: valid semantic mutations classified Violated / all valid semantic mutations

claim_boundary: This contract discriminates only the approved P1429 math.accent fragment. It does not classify a candidate, establish general math parity, prove render-byte equality, authorize changes outside the eight consumers, or attest isolation.
